title: 第13章 捕杀丛鹿第14章 偶遇小黑蛇
slug: 重生之为蚁第816章未知岛屿
content_zh:
十万大山之中处处都是险峰恶林，随处可见毒虫猛兽，参天的林木和山石组成的原始森林，使得这里成了野生动物的天堂。
此时，一片青山绿水，阳光明媚的好风光。这般风景若是放到地球上，那绝对能把所有的所谓旅游胜地比下去。可是在孙云看来，这绝美的风光，却只是一个巨大的猎场。
一只丛鹿悠闲的在丛林中觅食，确没有发现草丛中有三个抹满绿草液的脑袋！三个家伙鬼鬼祟祟，眼睛盯着丛鹿，还时不时的把仅剩的脑袋扎进土里，行事非常谨慎。
孙云三蚁，已经埋在土里两个时辰了，心里微微里有点着急！虽然孙云，已经达到三阶顶峰，但停留了有半年没提升了，所以经常带着护卫出来捕猎。
丛鹿是四阶魔兽，奔跑的速度和杀伤力极强的风刃，是丛鹿的生存法宝。如果远战的话，以孙云的实力肯定会被丛鹿吐的风刃干掉。孙云只有选择近战，才能有机会干掉这丛鹿。
但是，丛鹿在附近吃了半天了，丝毫没有过来的意思，几蚁已经浑身麻痹了。孙云现在，已经想放弃了，这比钓鱼还急人呢！
时间不负有心人，一向谨慎的丛鹿，还是慢慢靠近了这片鲜嫩的草丛。警惕的丛鹿，先用鼻子嗅了嗅，仔细确认着安全性！孙云三蚁，身子埋在土里，加上抹了大量的草液，影响了丛鹿的视觉和味觉，使丛鹿并没有发现。
丛鹿倒退两步，观察了一下，并没有异常，就低下头吃起来。当然，仍旧不时的抬头望一下远方，警惕的观察有没有天敌。
十米，八米，七米，六米，五米，四米，三米，两米，孙云三蚁大气都不敢出，把身体压的更低了。眼看就到了近前，三蚁的神经都紧绷起来，小奇和啊泰不时的看着孙云，焦急的等待孙云的命令。
嗖……嗖嗖……
就在距离不到一米的时候，孙云一个跳跃，扑到丛鹿脆弱的脖子上，咬住丛鹿的脖子。小奇和啊泰，也默契的跃到丛鹿身上，展开了攻击。小奇使用天赋变小向丛鹿耳朵钻去，啊泰选择在丛鹿头上，挥舞着巨木砸头。
呦呦……
丛鹿痛的原地乱跳，试图甩掉这些可恶的爬虫。
可怜的小奇，懊恼的被甩掉几次。让啊泰惊讶的是，这丛鹿的头太硬。跟随啊泰几年的巨木，都已经被砸断了，才使丛鹿产生眩晕而已！
“看我的！”
小奇逮住了机会，趁机钻入丛鹿的耳朵。
呦呦……
强烈的疼痛感，使得丛鹿更暴躁，疯狂的甩动着身体！
小奇可不会心软，疯狂的啃咬着，这可是来之不易的机会。这要是被弄出去，以它最差的实力，根本插不上手。
嘭……

啊泰没坚持多久，就被甩了下来。
嗖嗖……
几个风刃，直接在阿泰身边飞过，把啊泰打成重伤。
啊泰无奈，只能慌乱的逃走，躲避丛鹿的攻击。好在，丛鹿头和脖颈的疼痛，使得它无暇顾及重伤的啊康。丛鹿口吐几次风刃，都碰不到颈部的孙云，只不停的甩动，撞击大树。
现在的孙云，就像坐过山车一样眩晕，非常想呕吐。但是，生存的意识，使他死死的抓紧丛鹿脖颈撕咬。只要脱离丛鹿的身体，以丛鹿的速度，和魔法风刃，他们是没有生还的可能的。
折腾了差不多半个时辰，丛鹿渐渐的没有了力气，倒在了草地上，生命气息也渐渐流失。
呼哧呼哧……
孙云趴在地上，不停的喘息着。
至于，丛鹿的惨状，孙云也没有心情去看了，只想好好休息一下。什么危险的时候要冷静，孙云丝毫没找到这感觉，只知道为了活命，拼命的撕咬，不要停，也不能停。
“啊泰，小奇呢？”
休息了几分钟，孙云才突然发现，小奇不在了。
“呶，在那呢！”
啊康抬起爪子，示意了一下丛鹿脑袋。
“快！”
孙云一愣，赶紧扑上去。
丫的，不是闷死了吧？扑过去的孙云，赶紧破鹿头，生怕小奇被闷死里面。啊泰没有吱声，也上来帮忙，二蚁又疯狂的忙碌起来。
content_en:
There are dangerous peaks and evil forests everywhere among the hundreds of thousands of mountains, and poisonous insects and beasts can be seen everywhere. The primeval forest composed of towering trees and rocks makes this place a paradise for wild animals.
At this time, there is a beautiful scenery of green mountains, green waters and bright sunshine. If this kind of scenery were placed on Earth, it would definitely rival all the so-called tourist attractions. But in Sun Yun's view, this beautiful scenery is just a huge hunting ground.
A bush deer was leisurely looking for food in the jungle, but it did not notice three heads smeared with green grass liquid in the grass! The three guys were sneaky, staring at the deer, and from time to time they stuck their remaining heads into the soil, acting very cautiously.
Sun Yun's three ants have been buried in the soil for two hours, and they feel a little anxious! Although Sun Yun has reached the peak of the third level, he has not improved for half a year, so he often goes out to hunt with his guards.
Cong Lu is a fourth-level monster. Its running speed and extremely lethal wind blade are Cong Lu's magic weapon for survival. If he fought from a distance, Sun Yun would definitely be killed by Cong Lutu's wind blade with his strength. Only by choosing close combat could Sun Yun have a chance to kill the bunch of deer.
However, Cong Lu had been eating nearby for a long time and had no intention of coming over. The ants were already paralyzed. Sun Yun now wants to give up. This is more urgent than fishing!
Time paid off, and Cong Lu, who was always cautious, slowly approached the fresh grass. The vigilant Conglu sniffed it first, carefully confirming its safety! Sun Yun's three ants were buried in the soil and smeared with a large amount of grass liquid, which affected Cong Lu's vision and taste, so that Cong Lu did not notice it.
Cong Lu took two steps back, observed it, and found nothing unusual, so he lowered his head and started eating. Of course, I still look up into the distance from time to time and vigilantly observe whether there are any natural enemies.
Ten meters, eight meters, seven meters, six meters, five meters, four meters, three meters, two meters, Sun Yun and the three ants did not dare to breathe out, and pressed their bodies even lower. Seeing that they were approaching, the three ants' nerves became tense. Xiaoqi and Ah Tai looked at Sun Yun from time to time, anxiously waiting for Sun Yun's order.
Whoosh…whoosh…
When the distance was less than one meter, Sun Yun jumped, pounced on Cong Lu's fragile neck, and bit Cong Lu's neck. Xiao Qi and Ah Tai also jumped on Cong Lu in tacit understanding and launched an attack. Xiaoqi used his talent to become smaller and drilled into Cong Lu's ears. Ah Tai chose to hit Cong Lu's head with a giant tree.
Yoyo...
Cong Lu jumped on the spot in pain, trying to get rid of these nasty reptiles.
Poor Xiaoqi was thrown away several times to his chagrin. What surprised Ah Tai was that the deer's head was too hard. The huge trees that followed Ah Tai for several years have been smashed, which only made Cong Lu dizzy!
"Look at me!"
Xiaoqi seized the opportunity and took the opportunity to get into Cong Lu's ear.
Yoyo...
The intense pain made Cong Lu even more irritable, shaking his body crazily!
Xiaoqi will not be soft-hearted and bites it crazily. This is a hard-won opportunity. If it were to be taken out, with its worst strength, it would not be able to intervene at all.
Bang...
Ah Tai didn't last long before he was thrown off.
Whoosh…
Several wind blades flew directly beside Artai, seriously injuring Ah Tai.
Ah Tai had no choice but to run away in panic to avoid Cong Lu's attack. Fortunately, the pain in Cong Lu's head and neck prevented him from caring about the seriously injured Ah Kang. Cong Lu spit out the wind blade several times, but it could not touch Sun Yun's neck. He just kept swinging it and hitting the big tree.
Now Sun Yun was as dizzy as riding a roller coaster and wanted to vomit. However, the consciousness of survival made him cling to the deer's neck and bite it. As long as they break away from Cong Lu's body, with Cong Lu's speed and magical wind blade, there is no chance for them to survive.
After struggling for almost half an hour, Cong Lu gradually lost his strength and fell on the grass, with the breath of life gradually lost.
Huchihuchi…
Sun Yun lay on the ground, panting.
As for Cong Lu's tragic situation, Sun Yun was not in the mood to see it and just wanted to have a good rest. Sun Yun did not feel the need to be calm in times of danger. He only knew how to bite desperately in order to survive, without stopping or without stopping.
"Ah Tai, where is Xiaoqi?"
After resting for a few minutes, Sun Yun suddenly realized that Xiao Qi was no longer there.
"Hey, there it is!"
Ah Kang raised his paw and gestured to Cong Lu's head.
"Quick!"
Sun Yun was stunned and rushed forward.
Damn, aren’t you suffocated to death? Sun Yun rushed over and quickly broke the deer's head, fearing that Xiao Qi would be suffocated inside. Ah Tai didn't say anything, but also came to help, and the two ants were busy again.
